title: Read retry counts and exception history inside retry callbacks
summary: RetryTemplate supplied retry counts and original exception identities to listeners. Direct calls to the old methods of a CompositeRetryListener stopped reaching its legacy delegate on the landing.

change.description: RetryTemplate and CompositeRetryListener pass RetryState to new success and failure overloads. Their default implementations call the existing overloads.

notes: Template-driven legacy callbacks still worked, and both delegate orders retained the expected records. The direct-call parent delivered both events.
The identical application class on Spring 7.1.0 again received no events via the old direct overloads. All three template and composite controls retained their original histories.
